The route uses one deck for each case: the deck of the one-day workshop on methods of the housing-audit case in stages 1, 3 and 4, the deck of the immigration-and-trust case in stages 5 to 7, the deck of the cohabitation case in stages 8 and 9, and the full deck of the EU-frames case in stages 10 and 11. Each stage page opens the deck at the part that it uses. The decks were written to be presented, so open one in its own tab and press `s` for the speaker view, whose notes give what is said over each slide. The deck of the cohabitation case tells in Part 3 what Task 3 of that case asks you to find out for yourself, so leave it at the end of Part 2 until stage 9.

::: {.panel-tabset}
